Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Well spotted. I have double checked.

Submit - Corrected two typing mistakes and added one editorial correction. The correction was made by Wilcken, but did not enter BL III. It was repeated by Youtie (ZPE 12, 1973, p. 170) with correct attribution to Wilcken, but did not enter BL VII. I just gave the first occurrence of the correction to simplify the note. As the same situation repeats with the correction at l. 15, I gave there too the reference to Wilcken. Indeed, BL VII does not indicate this correction. Thank you for reviewing
Finalized - Ready.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Will need careful checking against the edition and BL. Use just the BL 7.194 after "=".

Submit - Text corrected according to BL VII and XIII. The corrections in older BL volumes were included and improved in BL VII, therefore they have not been recorded. Some remarks:
1. line numbering is problematic. I followed the new numbering by Youtie (BL 7). l. 21 linebreak was correctly recorded in editio princeps, but wrongly omitted in SB volume. l. 28 was omitted in editio princeps, and recorded first in BL 6 (with wrong reading) and 7.
2. I updated the vacats and punctuation to the text by Youtie without considering them editorial corrections
3. l. 2a, I did not known how to encode Youtie's (δι[δράχμων])
Thank you for reviewing!
Finalized - Ready.
